versions.localizedDescription:
**Nuvio Enhanced 0.3.1 Build 102**

**What’s New**
Added Favorite Actors. You can now add actors/people to favorites and access them quickly from your profile.
Added expanded Actor Pages with movies and series the person appeared in.
Added section arrows to actor/content sections so full lists can be opened on a separate page.
Added Search by Actor Name. Actor/person profiles now appear alongside movie and series search results.
Added experimental Download Notifications with progress, artwork, title info, and pause/resume/cancel actions.
Added background stream prefetch option in Enhanced settings.
Added AI Assistant settings/API fields to backup and restore.
Added improved subtitle language grouping. Cr: Russo #32 
Added redesigned Downloads experience inside Library.
Downloads now show as poster cards with progress, movie/show filters, and category filtering.
Added long-press actions for downloaded items: Play, Details, and Delete.
Downloaded content now saves richer title details for offline use.
Added subtitle font customization.
Added player overlay showing estimated media finish time.

**Improvements**
Improved stream loading flow by optionally starting stream fetching right after opening details.
Improved iOS 4K playback smoothness by enabling hardware decoder auto mode by default.
Improved player brightness handling so remembered brightness no longer causes app-level brightness locking/jumping.
Improved backup coverage for Enhanced/AI settings.
Improved actor/profile discovery from search and profile pages.
Improved download management visibility through system notifications.
Improved Downloads page layout by moving downloads into Library with clearer organization.
Improved poster long-press menus with blurred full-screen presentation and synopsis preview.
Improved profile poster loading and fallback artwork.
Improved Hero metadata loading speed and reliability.
Improved MDBList/rating display reliability.
Improved alternate app

**Nuvio Enhanced 0.2.23 Build 98**

**What's New**
- Added a cleaner long-press action menu for posters and episode cards.
- Added a compact synopsis preview inside the long-press action menu.
- Added a new Enhanced setting to show or hide the Android status bar across the app.

**Improvements**
- Restored the Home hero design closer to the original Nuvio look.
- Improved poster long-press previews with the correct artwork and full-screen blurred background.
- Improved tap-outside behavior for action menus.
- Improved Live TV playback compatibility for more M3U/M3U8 streams.
- Improved in-app update detection and APK install flow.
- Improved local crash reporting so device-specific crashes can be diagnosed faster.
- Removed heavy theme animation options that could cause stutter.

**Fixes**
- Fixed the Android status bar disappearing unexpectedly.
- Fixed poster action previews showing the wrong/cropped artwork.
- Fixed unwanted empty spaces around the poster action menu.
- Fixed Live TV streams that could stay stuck on the poster frame.
- Fixed several UI polish issues around hero, poster actions, and fullscreen behavior.

## Nuvio Enhanced 0.2.23 - Build 97

### Highlights
- Added experimental CloudStream support in Android full builds.
- Added Arabic and Russian language support.
- Added animated gradient themes. Credit: PR #17.
- Added upstream player zoom overlay support.
- Added a "Don't show again" option to the Discord popup.

### Improvements
- Added support for hiding stream sources that are still fetching or have no results, including addons, plugins, and CloudStream repositories.
- Added a setting to show or hide Hero ratings.
- Simplified Continue Watching badges and kept the "Next Episode Ready" prompt.
- Fixed Trakt login redirects for Nuvio Enhanced.
- Restored the AI assistant button on detail pages when configured.
- Improved synopsis placement and detail screen layout.
- Moved Hero Trailer Playback into Enhanced settings.
- Fixed CloudStream language fallback so non-Turkish languages use English.
- Improved profile entry and app startup stability.
- Synced the latest upstream Nuvio improvements included in this release.

### Fixes
- Prevented Hero trailer audio from continuing in the background or offscreen.
- Fixed CloudStream `.cs3 file size mismatch` issues in Android full builds.
- Removed the CloudStream "open plugin settings" action.
- Removed the in-app changelog section.
- Improved readability and contrast for Enhanced theme controls.

### Install Notes
- The Android APK is signed with the legacy Enhanced key for update compatibility with previous public builds.
- The iOS IPA is unsigned and must be signed before installing on a physical device.

### Checksums
- APK SHA-256: `4abc4ba6242b72ed42671aae849f229738d5f33c100c150d55b6240c4474d0b6`
- IPA SHA-256: `c7c7df7b7af9ab44df5e1f09b5c82d7591527f2789c302938f264390094c6196`

# Nuvio Enhanced v0.2.21 — Build 95

This release brings upstream Nuvio `0.2.20` and `0.2.21` updates together with the latest Enhanced Home, player, profile, and platform improvements.

## What's new

- The new Streaming Showcase Hero provides larger artwork, an overview, ratings, clearer actions, carousel indicators, and tighter spacing above Continue Watching.
- Hero refresh gestures now feel more natural without an intrusive refresh indicator.
- GIF avatars animate consistently across iOS profile areas and the Liquid Glass tab menu.
- An optional player status overlay can show the time, connection type, and battery level reported by the device while controls are visible.
- Deep links were added for addons and content details.
- External stream URLs now open in the appropriate external app or browser.
- The app-wide loading animation was refreshed.

## Home and scrolling

- Fixed the black empty space that could appear after pulling past the top on iOS and Android.
- The Home tab now preserves its state more reliably while navigating.
- Fixed overlap and excessive spacing between the Hero and Continue Watching sections.
- Home catalog synchronization keys are preserved more reliably.
- Periodic content and Trakt refresh behavior was restored.

## Continue Watching and Trakt

- Improved Trakt and Continue Watching synchronization.
- Fixed cases where playback progress, metadata, or next-episode information could be lost.
- Continue Watching metadata enrichment is now more reliable for movies and episodes.

## Player improvements

- Improved iOS player rotation behavior.
- Added protection against iOS AudioUnit-related crashes.
- Improved simulator-specific video output stability without changing the real-device VideoToolbox path.
- The player status overlay remains optional and is disabled by default.

## Performance and localization

- Reduced unnecessary Compose recompositions across Home, Hero, detail, and stream screens.
- Improved remote artwork and poster lo

# Enhanced v0.2.19 build 94

This release upgrades Nuvio Enhanced to upstream `0.2.19` and ships the latest community-requested Enhanced settings, plugin, hero, profile GIF, and package identity improvements.

## What's new

- Upstream `0.2.19` is included with iOS Now Playing support, Trakt sync and watched-state fixes, autoplay setting improvements, and new translations.
- Plugin settings were improved with quality/tag exclusion filters, quick repository switching, and bulk enable/disable controls for visible providers.
- Home hero artwork can now be switched between backdrop and poster artwork.
- The Home hero experience is cleaner: the refresh bubble is hidden, pull-down stretching feels more natural, and brief old-title flashes during hero cycling were fixed.
- Content warnings are now optional and can be turned off from Nuvio Enhanced settings.
- Nuvio Enhanced now uses the separate package/bundle id `com.nuvio.enhanced`, so it can be installed side by side with the original Nuvio app.
- The selected DNS over HTTPS provider is now highlighted more clearly.
- GIF search was added for profile images, and selected GIF avatars now animate again on iOS.

## Fixes and quality

- Android full release APK was built for package `com.nuvio.enhanced`, versionCode `94`, versionName `0.2.19`.
- iOS full unsigned IPA was built for bundle id `com.nuvio.enhanced`, version `0.2.19`, build `94`.
- Android full release APK build completed successfully.
- iOS simulator build installed and launched successfully after the GIF animation fix.
- iPhoneOS full build completed successfully and was packaged as an unsigned IPA.

## Artifacts

- Android full release APK: `Nuvio-Enhanced-v0.2.19-build94-full-release.apk`
- iOS full unsigned IPA: `Nuvio-Enhanced-v0.2.19-build94-full-unsigned.ipa`

## Notes

- Because the Android package id changed to `com.nuvio.enhanced`, this installs as a separate app instead of updating older `com.nuvio.app` builds.
- iOS IPA is unsigned; sign it with you
